title: Accounts Assistant
company: Macildowie Recruitment and Retention - Agency - Permanent
description:
Part-Time Finance Assistant - Temporary Contract

Location: Leicester
Contract: Temporary until December
Hours: 22 hours per week, part-time
Pay: Up to £13.50 per hour

We are looking for an organised and proactive Finance Assistant to join our team in Leicester on a part-time, temporary contract until December.

Reporting directly to the Finance Manager, you will support the day-to-day running of the finance function and help ensure financial transactions are processed accurately and efficiently.

Key responsibilities
- Processing and accurately recording supplier invoices
- Preparing supplier payment runs
- Raising and issuing customer invoices
- Carrying out credit control and following up on outstanding payments
- Completing bank reconciliations
- Responding to supplier and customer account queries
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date financial records
- Undertaking ad hoc finance duties as required

About you

The successful candidate will:
- Have previous experience in a finance, accounts or administrative role
- Be numerate, accurate and attentive to detail
- Have good organisational and time-management skills
- Be confident communicating with suppliers, customers and colleagues
- Be comfortable using Microsoft Excel and accounting software
- Be able to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines
- Work well independently and as part of a team
- Handle confidential information professionally

This role would suit someone who can quickly become an effective member of the team and provide reliable finance support throughout the temporary contract.

title: Part Time Accounts Assistant
company: Macildowie Recruitment and Retention - Agency - Permanent
description:
Part-Time Accounts Assistant Leicester City Centre Hybrid Temporary Ongoing Up to £16.00ph

Macildowie are working with a fantastic business based in Leicester City Centre looking for an experienced Accounts Assistant to join their finance team on an ongoing temporary basis.

The key details:
- Up to £16.00ph, depending on experience
- 3-4 days per week
- Flexible on working days and hours
- Hybrid working
- Leicester City Centre
- ASAP start - ideally next week
- Temporary ongoing position
- Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central experience is highly desirable, although not essential

This is a varied, hands-on transactional finance position covering both Purchase Ledger and Sales Ledger, alongside wider accounts administration.

Day-to-day duties will include:
- Processing purchase invoices and maintaining the Accounts Payable ledger
- Supplier statement reconciliations and resolving queries
- Raising and posting Sales Ledger invoices
- Processing credit cards and employee expenses
- Managing and reconciling foreign currency bank accounts
- Supporting general bank and balance sheet reconciliations
- Managing the shared finance mailbox
- Dealing with internal and external finance queries
- Supporting the wider finance team with general transactional accounting duties

We are looking for someone with previous Accounts Assistant / Finance Assistant / Purchase Ledger / Sales Ledger experience who can confidently pick up a varied workload and get up to speed quickly.

Experience using Microsoft Business Central would be a real advantage, but candidates with strong transactional finance experience using similar accounting systems will also be considered.

If you are available at short notice and looking for a flexible part-time opportunity, please apply or get in touch for more information.

title: Mental Health Act Administrator
description: Are you an experienced Mental Health Act Administrator with a passion for ensuring legal compliance and supporting excellent patient care? Elizabeth House is looking for a dedicated and organised Mental Health Act (MHA) Administrator to join our multidisciplinary team. This is an exciting opportunity to play a vital role in ensuring that all Mental Health Act processes are managed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with statutory requirements. As our MHA Administrator, you will work closely with the Hospital Director, Responsible Clinicians, nursing teams, and external agencies to ensure the hospital maintains the highest standards of legal compliance and governance. You will be responsible for the administration of all aspects of the Mental Health Act 1983 (as amended), ensuring legal documentation is accurate, compliant, and processed within statutory timescales. You will provide expert advice to staff, coordinate Mental Health Tribunal and Hospital Managers' Hearings, maintain legal records, and support the organisation during CQC inspections and internal audits. Key Responsibilities Administer all Mental Health Act documentation in line with current legislation and the Mental Health Act Code of Practice. Scrutinise detention papers for legal accuracy and identify any anomalies. Maintain the Mental Health Act Tracker and monitor statutory deadlines, renewals, consent to treatment requirements, and appeals. Coordinate Mental Health Tribunals and Hospital Managers' Hearings. Liaise with the Care Quality Commission (CQC), Tribunal Service, Responsible Clinicians, Independent Hospital Managers, IMHAs, and other stakeholders. Ensure statutory rights are explained and appropriate documentation is provided to patients. Maintain secure legal files and ensure clinical records are updated appropriately. Complete monthly audits of Mental Health Act documentation and legal files. Produce governance reports and compliance data. Provide advice and guidance to staff on Mental Health Act processes. Support the delivery of Mental Health Act training across the service.
